name: current-runtime-freeze
command: import {freezeBaseline} from './src/harness.mjs'; import {resolveConfig} from './src/config.mjs'; console.log('Selected current runtime'); await freezeBaseline(resolveConfig());

name: startup-bundle-layout
command: import {createRequire} from 'node:module'; const require=createRequire("/Applications/Ghost DSH Station.app/Contents/Resources/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/package.json"); const boot=require('@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot'); const rows=boot.loadOverlayPatches('dsh',new URL('./cordis.patch.yml',import.meta.url).pathname); console.log(JSON.stringify(rows,null,2)); const [insertion,...overrides]=rows; if(insertion?.insert?.length!==1||insertion.insert[0].id!=='harness2'||insertion.insert[0].name!=='dsh-plugin-harness2'||overrides.some(row=>typeof row.id!=='string'||!row.config||typeof row.config!=='object'||Array.isArray(row.config)||Object.keys(row).some(key=>!['id','config'].includes(key)))) throw Error('Unsupported bundle layout: dsh-plugin-harness2');
scope: Only scripts/project-plugins.mjs prepare source-route acceptance predicate. The packaged prepareStartupPlugins route differs; this is not a universal startup failure.

name: packaged-startup-composition
scope: Project packaged startup composer with isolated profile link and official DSH YAML loader. No dependency installation, Host, UI or model call.
